items.reason: AuthzClient.java:95 does initialize crypto before construction, and common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:60-61 throws when no provider is found. However, authz/client/src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.keycloak.common.crypto.CryptoProvider:20 explicitly registers the provider shipped by this PR. The alleged failure depends on downstream repackaging deleting required resources; the code does not establish a defective packaging path or a need to suppress initialization failures.
